description: Defines data structures related to PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) information, including codewords, precoding, power info, and scheduling details for 5G NR (New Radio) in a 3GPP-compliant system.

classes.name: pdsch_precoding_info
classes.description: Contains information about precoding resource block groups (PRGs) for PDSCH PDUs.

classes.name: pdsch_codeword
classes.description: Represents a PDSCH codeword with modulation, coding, and HARQ info.

classes.name: tx_power_pdsch_information
classes.description: Holds transmit power control offsets for PDSCH.

classes.name: pdsch_information
classes.description: Encapsulates all scheduling and configuration info for a PDSCH grant.

classes.name: ta_cmd_ce_payload
classes.description: Timing Advance Command Control Element payload.

classes.name: dl_msg_lc_info
classes.description: Information about logical channels scheduled in a downlink message.

classes.name: dl_msg_tb_info
classes.description: Transport block info including logical channels to schedule.

classes.name: dl_msg_alloc
classes.description: Represents a dedicated downlink grant for UEs, including scheduling info and context.

classes.name: rar_ul_grant
classes.description: Uplink grant within a RAR (Random Access Response).

classes.name: sib_information
classes.description: Information about SIB1 or other System Information messages.

classes.name: dl_broadcast_allocation
classes.description: Downlink broadcast allocation including SSBs and SIBs.

classes.name: dl_paging_allocation
classes.description: Paging allocation details including UE list and PDSCH config.
